text.p: Indonesia's PT Peregrine Sewu Securities has rated commodity trading firm PT Prasidha Aneka Niaga a "buy" in the wake of strong coffee prices.

Peregrine said in a report it had revised up Prasidha's 1997 net profit target to 40.6 billion rupiah, with earnings per share of 338 rupiah, from 33 billion rupiah on the back of 34 percent increase in global coffee prices since early 1997.

"We expect coffee prices will remain strong this year due to a poor harvest in Brazil, a labour strike in Columbia, and the recent agreement by the Association of Coffee Producing Countries to cut global coffee export this year," the report said.
Peregrine said the stock was trading on 1997 price earnings of 10.4 times, which was considered cheap in the light of an estimated 32 percent increase in earnings per share in 1997.

The report said an expected two-for-one bonus issue and stock split later this year, combined with Prasidha's plan for a placement to increase the free float from 29 percent to around 40 percent was likely to improve liquidity. Prasidha rose 25 rupiah to 3,575 rupiah in late morning trading on Friday, on a volume of 193,000 shares.
